weeks.sub_strand: Decimal Operations to Thousandths & Geosphere-Hydrosphere Interactions
learning_outcomes: Read, write, and compare decimals to thousandths

lessons.subject: Common Core Math (5.NBT)
lessons.topic: Powers of 10 & Multiplying Decimals
lessons.parent_script: How does shifting a decimal point one place to the right change its value? Let us discover the power of 10 patterns.
lessons.learning_objective: Explain patterns in the number of zeros of the product when multiplying by powers of 10.
lessons.step_by_step_activity:
1. Model 0.4 x 10 and 0.4 x 100 on grid paper.
2. Derive exponent rules for 10^1, 10^2, 10^3.
3. Complete 10 multi-step decimal problems.

lessons.subject: NGSS Science (5-ESS2 Earth Systems)
lessons.topic: Interactions of Geosphere, Hydrosphere, Atmosphere, and Biosphere
lessons.parent_script: Earth is a giant interconnected system. How does the water cycle connect the ocean (hydrosphere) to the air (atmosphere)?
lessons.learning_objective: Develop a model using an example to describe ways the geosphere, biosphere, hydrosphere, and atmosphere interact.
lessons.step_by_step_activity:
1. Create a closed terrarium / water cycle cloud in a jar.
2. Observe condensation and precipitation cycles.
3. Diagram the 4 spheres interacting in your neighborhood.

lessons.subject: CCSS ELA (Reading Informational Text 5.RI)
lessons.topic: Citing Text Evidence in Informational Articles
lessons.parent_script: Whenever we make an assertion about a text, we must prove it with direct evidence: According to paragraph 2...
lessons.learning_objective: Quote accurately from a text when explaining what the text says explicitly and when drawing inferences.
lessons.step_by_step_activity:
1. Read the article on renewable solar energy.
2. Highlight author claim in green and supporting statistics in yellow.
3. Write a 3-paragraph summary with 2 direct quotes.
